_meta.purpose: Schema for prop price ingestion. Populate manually or via API. One entry per player-market-book combination.
_meta.status: template — no live API integration yet
_meta.upgrade_path: Connect to The Odds API or DraftKings/FanDuel feed for live population

player.notes: Last name, First name preferred for sorting

market.notes: TB_1 = over 0.5 TB; TB_2 = over 1.5 TB; Hits_1 = 1+ hits

odds_american.notes: Positive = underdog price (e.g., +135). Negative = favorite price (e.g., -155). No '+' prefix in storage.

no_vig_probability.notes: Computed after vig removal. For props with no listed 'other side', use standard 6% hold removal: implied_prob / 0.94

timestamp_pulled.notes: When this price was observed. Critical for CLV and stale-line detection.

movement_cents.notes: Current implied prob minus open implied prob in basis points

sharp_flag.notes: True if movement >15 cents in a single direction — potential sharp action

closing_line.notes: Fill in AFTER first pitch. American odds at market close. Used for CLV calculation.

clv.notes: Computed post-game: no_vig_prob_at_bet - no_vig_prob_at_close. Positive = got better than close (good). Negative = got worse than close (bad).

best_available_flag.notes: True if this is the best price across all books checked for this player-market combination

baseball_grade.notes: From dual_grade_framework.md — assigned at analysis time

bet_grade.notes: Assigned after price pull and EV calculation

fair_probability.notes: Model-estimated true probability. From: base_rate x pitcher_factor x park_factor x weather_factor x form_factor

ev.notes: Expected value per unit: (fair_prob x odds_decimal) - 1. Positive = +EV. Negative = -EV.
